findings.summary: Interruption recovery is asserted in the same REPL after a failed invocation. If a partial empty CJS module loaded successfully before invocation failed, real Node retains that module after files change. I6 does not promise require-cache refresh. Verify post-reapply recovery in a fresh Worker/Node invocation, or explicitly remove the test-owned cache entry; do not add an unrequested SDK cache-reset guarantee.
findings.evidence: Executed node --input-type=module with mkdtemp empty partial.cjs, require(target)("2 days"), overwrite with a function returning 172800000, repeat, then delete require.cache[require.resolve(target)] and repeat.
